name: OKX NFT Aggregator
rootCause: Publicly available evidence for a reported 2024 OKX NFT Aggregator incident on BNB Chain remains limited. DefiLlama catalogued a roughly $14,000 loss on 2024-06-20 under an improper access control classification, but no primary transaction records, vulnerable contract disclosures, or technical postmortems were identified during this review. The only consistently reported classification is improper access control. No public postmortem, verified vulnerable contract, or independently confirmed exploit transaction was identified, so the exact authorization failure remains unknown.
